# Cars24 Logo Assets — Ready to Paste

Load this file whenever a Cars24 logo is needed. Copy the correct block below directly into the creative. Do not read the SVG or PNG source files separately. Do not approximate, redraw, or typeset the logo.

## Which asset to use

| Background | Format | Block to use |
|---|---|---|
| Dark / brand purple `#4736FE` | SVG | **SVG — White (Group.svg)** |
| Dark / brand purple `#4736FE` (alt) | SVG | **SVG — White alt (Group-2.svg)** |
| Light / white / pale | SVG | **SVG — Blue (Group-1.svg)** |
| High-contrast light / print | SVG | **SVG — Black (Group-3.svg)** |
| Dark / brand purple — raster/email | PNG `<img>` | **PNG — White** |
| Light / white / pale — raster/email | PNG `<img>` | **PNG — Blue** |
| High-contrast light / print — raster/email | PNG `<img>` | **PNG — Black** |

**Placement:** bottom-left (or top-left) · ≥16 px clear space · `height: 32px` default · no recolouring, stretching, rotating, or CSS filters.
